definitions.title: The Whim's Missing Machine
definitions.body: With the Tooth Collector safe, the Whim admits the Wrong Machine is missing. Kobolds in the Mountains may know where it went. The Whim asks your warband to follow their trail; you do not have the machine yet.

choices.label: Follow the Mountains lead
choices.response: The Whim opens the path to the Mountains. Find the kobolds and learn what happened to the Wrong Machine.
